name: Step Two: More Rock
summary: Hamur in Bolder'ok wants Heavy Weightstones to strengthen a weapon. He says rock makes rock stronger, and asks you to bring more.

sections.title: Hamur's Request
sections.body: Hamur in Bolder'ok says a weapon needs a finishing touch: more rock. He has seen small folk make Heavy Weightstones, and asks you to bring them so he can strengthen the weapon.

faq.answer: Hamur in Bolder'ok asks you to bring Heavy Weightstones.

faq.q: What does Hamur want them for?
faq.answer: Hamur says he will use the Heavy Weightstones to strengthen a weapon.

faq.q: What does Hamur say makes rock stronger?
faq.answer: Hamur says that only rock can make rock stronger.
